description: Get the full listing for one upcoming event by the `id` that search_events or list_upcoming returned, passing the same `city` it came from: title, dates, venue, price (all-in, or "See tickets"), the original listing (`link`), every source that lists it and first_seen / last_seen / last_fetched dates. Ids stay the same while an event is listed; a past or removed event returns an error, so search again. (search_across_cities results carry `on_site` links instead.) No sign-in; each client gets 30 calls a minute and 2,500 event rows an hour.
